trailhead.label: The via Pietro Valsecchi car park at Scarenna, Asso, the published start

cautions: About a quarter on village lanes and paved forest roads with some cars: keep your dog close there.
Steps and steep earth paths near the earth pyramids, slippery after rain.
The earth pyramids are fragile: keep your dog off them and on the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Asso to the earth pyramids of Rezzago: Da Asso ai funghi di terra di Rezzago
textIt.The via Pietro Valsecchi car park at Sca: Il parcheggio di via Pietro Valsecchi a Scarenna, Asso, la partenza indicata dal portale
textIt.About a quarter on village lanes and pav: Circa un quarto su stradine di paese e strade forestali asfaltate con qualche auto: lì tenete il cane vicino.
textIt.Steps and steep earth paths near the ear: Gradini e sentieri di terra ripidi vicino ai funghi di terra, scivolosi dopo la pioggia.
textIt.The earth pyramids are fragile: keep you: I funghi di terra sono fragili: tenete il cane lontano da essi e sul sentiero.
